title: Blink
contents: text | At the end of each turn, roll d20. On 11 or higher, you vanish to the Ethereal Plane.
text | At start of next turn, reappear in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of where you vanished.

title: Contact Other Plane
contents: text | Make a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw. On fail, take 6d6 psychic damage and go insane for 1 minute.
text | On success, ask 5 questions with yes/no/unclear/irrelevant answers.

title: Dream
contents: text | Send a phantasmal messenger into a target’s dream.
text | You can appear and converse.
text | If you change form to a nightmare, target takes 3d6 psychic damage and gains no rest.

title: Hold Monster
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (a small straight piece of iron)
text | Choose a creature. It makes a Wisdom saving throw or becomes paralyzed for the duration.
text | Target may repeat the save at the end of each turn.

title: Jallarzi's Storm of Radiance
contents: text | Radiant energy pulses in a 20-foot radius. Creatures in the area make a Constitution saving throw.
text | On fail, take 4d10 radiant damage and are blinded. Half on success.

title: Mislead
contents: text | Turn invisible and create an illusory double.
text | You can move it and perceive through it using your action.
text | The illusion lasts until the spell ends or you dismiss it.

title: Planar Binding
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (jewel worth at least 1,000 gp)
text | Bind a celestial, elemental, fey, or fiend within range that is already charmed or restrained.
text | It must make a Charisma saving throw. On a fail, it is bound to serve you for the duration.
text | At Higher Levels. Duration increases: 10 days (6th), 30 days (7th), 180 days (8th), 1 year (9th).

title: Plant Growth
contents: text | In 1 action: Plants in a 100-foot radius become thick and overgrown. Movement through them costs 4 feet per 1.
text | In 8 hours: Enrich land. Crops yield double for 1 year.

title: Scrying
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (focus worth at least 1,000 gp)
text | You create an invisible sensor to spy on a creature you know.
text | The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. Bonuses or penalties apply based on how well you know them and physical connection.
text | On fail, you can see and hear through the sensor within 10 feet of the target.

title: Synaptic Static
contents: text | Creatures in a 20-foot radius sphere make an Intelligence saving throw.
text | On a fail, take 8d6 psychic damage and subtract 1d6 from attacks, checks, and saves for 1 minute.
text | Save again at end of each turn to end the effect.

title: Teleportation Circle
contents: text | ComponentsV, M (rare chalks and inks worth 50 gp)
text | Draw a sigil linking to a permanent teleportation circle you know.
text | Opens a portal for 1 round. Creatures within the circle teleport to the destination.
